facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology tabled a 2026/27 budget of TZS 222,589,451,000 (about USD 89 million): TZS 13.1 billion recurrent and TZS 209.4 billion development, of which TZS 98.5 billion is from domestic sources and TZS 110.9 billion from external financing.

note: Page gives no 2025/26 figure for the ministry, so no rose or fell; the TZS 5 billion startup loan fund invests in private firms and is class other; the page date is 2026-05-01; the page gives no date for the budget presentation, so as_of is the page date.
